units.source_text: 父親在東京有很多公務，在上野的櫻花町擁有別墅，每個月的大半時間都在東京的別墅裡度過。

en.t: My father had a great deal of official business in Tokyo, and owned a villa in Sakuragicho in Ueno; he spent most of every month at that Tokyo villa.

units.source_text: 回老家時，總喜歡給家人和親戚買回很多禮物，這好像是父親的嗜好。

en.t: When he returned to our family home, he always liked to bring back many gifts for the family and relatives; that seemed to be Father's hobby.

units.source_text: 有一次，父親在赴京前，把孩子們召集到客廳，

en.t: Once, before Father went up to Tokyo, he gathered the children in the parlor,

units.source_text: 笑著問每個孩子，下次回來時想要什麼禮物，

en.t: and, smiling, asked each child what present they wanted him to bring back next time,

units.source_text: 並把孩子們的要求一一寫在記事本上。

en.t: and wrote down each of the children's requests in his notebook.

units.source_text: 父親對孩子們如此親切，真是罕見。

en.t: It was truly rare for Father to be so kind and familiar with the children.

units.source_text: 「葉藏呢？」被父親這麼一問，我一下子無言以對。

en.t: "What about you, Yozo?" When Father asked me that, I suddenly had no answer.

units.source_text: 一旦被人問起想要什麼，剎那間，我反而什麼都不想要了。

en.t: Whenever someone asked me what I wanted, in that instant I instead wanted nothing at all.
